en.quote: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God's host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.

en.quote: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.
en.riddle: and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.
en.speaker: Jacob
